title: Yellowed Pillowy Turkish Udon Noodles Cig Kofte
description: A kid-friendly Turkish dish featuring udon noodles, beurre-monte, and low-calorie ingredients, formed into cig-kofte shapes. This resinous and pillowy dish is a unique twist on traditional Turkish cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked ground turkey, sauteed onion and garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add the cooked udon noodles to the bowl and mix until the noodles are well coated with the turkey mixture.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into small cig-kofte shapes.
Place the shaped cig-kofte on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with beurre-monte.
Bake the cig-kofte in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until lightly browned.
